learningRoadmap.title: Learning Roadmap
learningRoadmap.subtitle: Skills and exams on one map, paced by evidence-based study science
learningRoadmap.emptyState: No goals yet. Add a skill or exam goal to get started

recs.noActiveGoals: No active goals. Add one to start pace analysis
recs.massedPractice: {pct}% of the last two weeks' study landed on just two days. The same total time spread over more days sticks far better (spacing effect)
recs.retrievalBacklog: {count} vocabulary cards are past due. Recalling beats re-reading (testing effect)
recs.lowAdherence: You met the {quota}-minute daily quota on only {adherence}% of the last 7 days. Short daily sessions beat rare long ones
recs.deadlineAtRisk: "{title}" is {daysLeft} days away but you averaged {avg} min/day (target {quota}). Distribute the work now, before cramming is the only option
recs.zeigarnikResume: {count} tasks are in progress. Unfinished work stays vivid in memory — picking up where you left off is the lowest-willpower way to start today
recs.blockedPractice: {pct}% of the last 7 days' study went to "{title}". Alternating between goals builds stronger, more transferable retention
recs.longSessions: Your study blocks average {avg} minutes. Splitting into 25-50 minute chunks with breaks keeps focus and retention high
recs.onTrack: On track — {streak}-day streak going. Keep the rhythm
